pipeline_versions.Name: v1
pipeline_versions.PipelineSpec:
components:
  comp-hello-world:
    executorLabel: exec-hello-world
    inputDefinitions:
      parameters:
        text:
          parameterType: STRING
deploymentSpec:
  executors:
    exec-hello-world:
      container:
        args:
        - "--text"
        - "{{$.inputs.parameters['text']}}"
        command:
        - sh
        - "-ec"
        - |
          program_path=$(mktemp)
          printf "%s" "$0" > "$program_path"
          python3 -u "$program_path" "$@"
        - |
          def hello_world(text):
              print(text)
              return text

          import argparse
          _parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='Hello world', description='')
          _parser.add_argument("--text", dest="text", type=str, required=True, default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
          _parsed_args = vars(_parser.parse_args())

          _outputs = hello_world(**_parsed_args)
        image: python:3.11
pipelineInfo:
  name: hello-world
root:
  dag:
    tasks:
      hello-world:
        cachingOptions:
          enableCache: true
        componentRef:
          name: comp-hello-world
        inputs:
          parameters:
            text:
              componentInputParameter: text
        taskInfo:
          name: hello-world
  inputDefinitions:
    parameters:
      text:
        parameterType: STRING
schemaVersion: 2.1.0
sdkVersion: kfp-1.6.5
